why: Holmes says at ¶231, 'This is Clapham Junction, if I am not mistaken,' so the story states it.
¶231 says 'we shall be in Victoria in less than ten minutes,' so Victoria is the stated destination of the train.
¶183 sets the race at Winchester four days after the earlier scene, and ¶215 says that evening they were whirling back to London; the train passes Clapham Junction on that return journey.
